<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Add and remove Gmail labels. Refs come from the arguments, or one per line on stdin when the only argument is -.

## Usage

```text
chainmail label <ref>... [--add <label>]... [--remove <label>]... [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail label cm1:gmail:INBOX:3:17:g1790000000000000001 --add Receipts --remove Todo
```

## Flags

```text
      --add stringArray      a label to add, created if missing (repeatable)
      --remove stringArray   a label to remove (repeatable)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
